description: Zero-Trust Enterprise Compliance: Exports an immutable, tamper-evident audit log in SIEM standard formats (CEF / ArcSight, RFC 5424 Syslog, JSONL, or JSON) with zero plaintext PII leakage. Can write directly to a local log file or stream.

company_name.description: Optional company name for enterprise audit attribution. Defaults to 'PrivacyScrubber Client'.

department.description: Optional department or auditor identifier. Defaults to 'SecOps / Compliance'.

destination_file.description: Optional local file path to append the audit log event to (e.g. '/var/log/privacyscrubber.log').

format.description: Audit log format: 'jsonl' (Datadog/ELK), 'cef' (ArcSight/Splunk), 'syslog' (RFC 5424), 'json', or 'markdown'. Defaults to 'jsonl'.

session_id.description: Optional session ID for isolated multi-task agent memory. Defaults to 'default'.

text.description: Optional raw text to sanitize and include in the exported audit log event.

name: export_audit_log
